finding: The prior VT04 comparator checked finite numerical content only for the candidate Vapor-on BFO. Preserved raw outputs show the Vapor-on control contains NaN fields while the candidate is finite.
gate_effect: The preregistered full-model gate required finite outputs for both executables. Therefore F-PDI-VT04 cannot be treated as a complete PASS under that gate, despite normal completion and the valid NoVap identity result.
repair_rule: Do not weaken or rewrite the gate. Add a separate representative dry case in which both control and candidate remain finite, while retaining enough vapor contribution to produce a measurable difference.
nonclaim: This failure does not invalidate the confirmed Celsius/Kelvin defect or the function-level qualification.
